How to use the ALAGO app

From signing in to reviewing your application.

  1. 1

    Open the app

    Start in the ALAGO app and read the information on the welcome screen.

  2. 2

    Sign in

    Use your phone number and follow the instructions in the app.

  3. 3

    Review & apply

    Provide the requested details. Read the costs and repayment schedule before accepting an offer.

  4. 4

    Check your result

    An application is subject to review. Follow the next steps shown in your app.
